title: A navigation benchmark run keeps its raw claude stream-json beside the parsed row
goal: bench_lookup.nav_run writes each run's raw stdout to a file beside the row of navigation-<date>-runs.jsonl in the benchmark scratch directory, so a recorded stream exists to turn into a redacted fixture; a test plants a fake claude and sees the stdout kept; found by BG-nhfhifpe, which waits on a recorded stream
